_comment: Every line of text in the game. Dialogue values may be a list: one entry per page.
title.name: LANTERN OF ELDERMOOR
menu.empty: Nothing yet. Go and find something.
map.nomap: No map of this temple yet.
get.sword: You lift your master's blade. It is lighter than it looks.
Press A to swing. Hold A to gather a spin.
get.shield: An oak shield. Hold L and nothing gets past you.
get.lantern: The Little Lantern! Its flame does not go out.
Set it to B, X or Y, then press that button to light torches and burn webs.
get.feather: The Updraft Feather. Press its button to hop a gap.
get.bombs: Fen Bombs. Ten of them, and they crack more than rock.
get.bottle: An empty bottle. Something will want to live in it.
get.map: A map of the temple. Press Select to read it.
get.compass: The compass. Now you can feel where the chests are.
get.bigkey: The Great Key. One door in this temple will know it.
get.heart_piece: A piece of heart. Four make one whole.
get.heart_piece_full: A piece of heart - and that makes four! Your heart grows.
get.heart_container: A whole heart. You stand a little straighter.
get.shell: A seashell, far from any sea.
get.flame.temple1: The first Flame comes to your wick without a sound.
One of eight. The mist on the meadow thins a little.
Take it home to the Great Lantern.
door.locked: Locked. A small key would turn it.
door.bigkey: This lock is far too grand for a small key.
shop.title: WARES
shop.hello: Mind the lamp oil. Take what you can pay for.
shop.sold: You already have one of those.
sign.blank: The paint has run off this one.
sign.village: LAMPLIGHT VILLAGE - keep the wicks trimmed.
sign.north: NORTH: the meadow road. Mind the thistles.
sign.temple: TEMPLE OF THE FIRST FLAME. Closed by order of nobody at all.
sign.shop: WARES. Knock if the door sticks.
npc.elder.1: Wren. The Great Lantern has gone out - all eight flames taken.
Eight temples, eight thieves, eight flames. You are the only lamplighter left standing.
Take the north road. The first temple is past the meadow.
npc.elder.2: One flame home. Seven to go, and the mist knows it.
npc.shop.1: Sixty embers for the shield. Cut the grass, it pays.
npc.kid.1: I saw a thing in the long grass. It had TEETH.
npc.kid.2: You went in the temple? With that little lantern?
npc.fisher.1: Fish won't rise while the mist sits on the water.
npc.baker.1: Eat before you go. The temple does not do suppers.
npc.guard.1: Nobody goes up the north road at night. Nobody sensible.
npc.guard.2: You came back. That's one more than I expected.
npc.wren_home: Your own bed. It will still be here afterwards.
story.temple1.enter: Something far below is breathing warm air up the stairs.
story.temple1.miniboss: The floor cracks. Something with a jaw comes up through it.
bestiary.mote: A knot of leftover fire. Hops. Does not think.
bestiary.thistle: Hides in the long grass until you are close enough to regret it.
bestiary.crag: Armour on the front, temper at the back. Get behind it.
bestiary.wisp: Walls mean nothing to it. Neither does hurry.
bestiary.spitter: Rooted. Winds up before it spits, which is the only kind thing about it.
bestiary.burrow: Travels under the floor and comes up where you were standing.
bestiary.cinderjaw: It circles, it slams, and then it is stuck for a moment. That moment is yours.
bestiary.ashmaw: Shut, it is a wall. Light the four torches and it opens.
hint.lantern: Set the Lantern to a button in the ITEMS menu first.
warp.lit: The warp lantern takes your flame. You can come back to this one from the map.
sign.bramble: BRAMBLE HOLLOW. The thorns grow back by morning.
sign.glade: THE HOLLOW GLADE. Quiet, isn't it.
get.bracelet: The Power Bracelet. Stone feels like bread now.
Press A at a rock or a pot to lift it, and A again to throw it.
get.flame.temple2: The second Flame settles on your wick.
Two of eight. The thorns along the north road look thinner.
bestiary.thornjaw: It rolls, it stops, and for a moment it is only a rock.
bestiary.hollowking: Throw the temple back at it.
story.temple2.enter: Roots have got in through the roof. Something has been using them.
get.hookshot: The Fen Hookshot. Six tiles of chain and a very rude claw.
Fire it at a pillar to be pulled across whatever is in between.
get.bow: The Reedwood Bow, and thirty arrows.
Arrows reach switches, eyes and anything that will not come down.
get.flame.temple3: The third Flame comes up out of the water dry.
Three of eight. The tide is going back out.
get.flame.temple4: The fourth Flame. The glass hums as it leaves.
Four of eight. Half the Great Lantern is lit again.
bestiary.brinejaw: It comes in with the water and goes out with it.
bestiary.tideclaw: Its shell opens only when the chain is in it.
bestiary.sandjaw: It swims in the sand, which is worse than it sounds.
bestiary.glassmaw: Put an arrow in the eye that is open.
story.temple3.enter: The floor is wet and the walls are wetter.
story.temple4.enter: Sand runs between the stones here, a grain at a time.
get.fins: Tidewrack Fins. Deep water is only water now.
get.fire_boots: Cinderstep Boots. Lava is warm, and ice is temporary.
get.mirror_cloak: The Mirror Cloak. Hold its button and the world looks past you.
What is thrown at you comes back the way it came.
get.gauntlet: The Titan Gauntlet. The heavy blocks are not heavy any more.
get.whistle: The Whistle of Winds. Blow it anywhere and the lanterns answer.
whistle.nowarp: Nothing answers. Light a warp lantern first.
bestiary.sentinel: It only hurts what it can see. Put the cloak on.
bestiary.weedjaw: It waits where the water is deepest, which is everywhere here.
bestiary.drownking: Wait for the water to go out of it.
bestiary.slagjaw: Still half molten. Let it cool, then hit it.
bestiary.kilnmaw: The kiln has a door. Open it.
bestiary.glassking: It cannot see the cloak, and it hates that.
bestiary.stonejaw: It was a wall once and it has not forgiven anyone.
bestiary.titanmaw: The last of the eight, and the heaviest.
bestiary.thequiet: It is what is left when every lamp goes out.
story.temple5.enter: Everything down here has been underwater, and most of it still is.
story.temple6.enter: The air shimmers. The floor is warm through your boots.
story.temple7.enter: Every wall is a mirror, and every mirror is watching.
story.temple8.enter: Blocks the size of houses. Someone moved them once.
story.temple9.enter: The Great Lantern stands open and empty.
get.flame.temple5: The fifth Flame, wrung out and still burning.
get.flame.temple6: The sixth Flame. It barely notices you.
get.flame.temple7: The seventh Flame, and a hundred reflections of it.
get.flame.temple8: The eighth Flame. Every one of them is yours now.
Take them to the Great Lantern.
ending.short: The Quiet goes out like a wick pinched between two fingers.
Wren sets eight Flames back in the Great Lantern, one at a time, and the mist goes down off the meadow like a sheet being pulled off furniture.
Lamplight Village can see its own north road again.
Somewhere out in the Mistlands, something is still unlit.
ending.full: The Quiet goes out like a wick pinched between two fingers.

Wren sets eight Flames back in the Great Lantern, and this time there is nothing left in the dark to take them again: every shell is found, every heart is whole, every grotto on the island has had a lamplighter in it.
The mist does not retreat. It simply stops being there.
The elder says the Lantern has not burned this bright since before he was born, and then he says it twice more, to different people, with more detail each time.
Wren puts the little lantern back on its hook by the door, where it can be reached quickly.
sign.great_lantern: The door has eight sockets and no handle. Eight flames are missing from it.
sign.great_lantern_open: Eight flames burn in the door. It stands open.
